name: Podio

evidence.quote: Our API supports different OAuth flows depending on what kind of integration you are making.
Get started right away - generate your API key.
API Integrations 1000 calls per hour
Hooks are webhooks that can call external sites when certain actions occur in Podio.
The Podio MCP Server is currently in beta and is intended for evaluation and testing.

notes: Free plan exists (100-item cap) and API at 1000 calls/hour is listed for Free on pricing; API key = OAuth client id/secret self-generated. Official hosted MCP at mcp.podio.com/mcp (beta, OAuth). Podio is now documented under Progress (ShareFile). Verdict easy; MCP beta is only a minor caveat.

name: Copper

evidence.quote: API Keys are suitable for individual users, while OAuth2.0 is the preferred approach for partner integrations.
Only Admin users are able to generate API Keys.
Start free, no credit card required.
The Copper Developer API ("Dev API") provides a RESTful interface with JSON-formatted responses to access most Copper resources.
MCP server for the Copper CRM API.

notes: No free plan: paid per-seat plans ($29+) with a free trial; key issued from Settings > Integrations > API Keys by admins only. Exact plan tier that unlocks API not verifiable from rendered pricing table (feature row 'API & Embedded integration SDK' present). No vendor MCP found; community server by dazanza plus many aggregators.

name: Intercom

evidence.quote: You want to run scripts to create or get data from your Intercom workspace
Development workspaces are free and intended for development purposes only.
these will go up for review when you submit your app for review
Intercom workspaces can be hosted in three distinct regions - US, EU and Australia.
The Intercom MCP server is available for US and EU hosted workspaces. AU hosted workspaces are not yet supported.

notes: Private apps use a workspace Access Token (bearer); public apps use OAuth and App Store review. Free unlimited dev workspaces. Regional hosts api.eu/api.au (US host attempts routing). access_prod: private-app access token on a paid customer workspace is self-serve; partner_review applies only to public/OAuth distribution. Official remote MCP mcp.intercom.com / mcp.eu.intercom.com.

name: Gorgias

evidence.quote: Use your email (username) and your API key
You don't need to follow any special process to create a private app.
Start free. No credit card required. Live on your store in under an hour.
--url https://your-domain.gorgias.com/api/tickets \
a first-party server that plugs your workspace into Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and any MCP-compatible tool.

notes: Private app = HTTP Basic (email + API key) on per-account host your-domain.gorgias.com. Public apps require OAuth2 plus Gorgias review; sandbox requires emailing techpartners. Free trial then paid. Official MCP in open beta, any plan; some writes gated.

name: Lark (Larksuite)

evidence.quote: Obtain the App ID and App Secret, which will be used for API authentication
Lark offers multiple pricing plans from a free starter pack to a pro and an enterprise plan.
Click "Console" and create a new application
This tool is currently in Beta stage.

notes: Lark Open Platform docs (open.larksuite.com) are JS-rendered and could not be read directly; token types (tenant_access_token via App ID/Secret = 'other', user_access_token via OAuth, sent as Bearer) taken from the vendor's own GitHub README, which recommends --token-mode user_access_token. Free Starter plan exists; self-serve developer console. Official MCP is local (npx @larksuiteoapi/lark-mcp) published by the larksuite org, beta; no hosted remote MCP verified. Feishu (China) is a separate host; Lark international uses open.larksuite.com. Tenant-admin approval of custom app releases may add friction but was not verifiable from readable pages.

name: Aircall

evidence.quote: Aircall will generate two strings: an API ID and an API token, which act as your username and password.
Yes. Aircall offers free access to test the platform before committing.
To build one, you must first join the Aircall Technology Partner Program
All plans include API access and 250+ integrations.
As of this writting we don't offer an MCP servier but stay tuned.

notes: Private app: API ID/token via Basic auth generated in Dashboard > Integrations > API keys (admin dashboard). Public/OAuth apps require Tech Partner Program. Plans paid, min 3 licenses; free test access available. Vendor states no official MCP; community servers exist (e.g. lobehub listings), not verified on GitHub.

name: LinkedIn Ads

evidence.quote: Your application directs the browser to LinkedIn's OAuth 2.0 authorization page where the member authenticates.
Step 1: Apply for API Access
All applications start with Development tier. You must apply separately to upgrade to the Standard tier.
Available to all developers approved for Advertising API access.
LinkedIn Ads MCP — MCP server for the LinkedIn Marketing API.

notes: Advertising API requires submitting an access form and LinkedIn approval even for Development tier (edit up to 5 ad accounts); Standard tier needs a second application. 3-legged OAuth only. No official LinkedIn MCP (community package by Nuraveda Lab states there is none).

name: Klaviyo

evidence.quote: Private API keys can be used to read and write data to your Klaviyo account.
Up to 250 active profiles and 500 emails per month
All /api endpoints use API private keys to authenticate requests.
configure your MCP client for the remote-hosted server (recommended) or the local server

notes: Free plan (250 profiles) with self-generated private API keys; OAuth recommended for tech partners/App Marketplace listing. Official MCP offered both remote-hosted and local.

name: Ecwid

evidence.quote: Ecwid uses OAuth 2.0 to provide secure access to the store data for public apps.
Only stores on paid plans can access API.
Secret token grants full access to REST API (provided the app has all required permissions)
Ecwid by Lightspeed MCP Server - MCP AI | Zapier

notes: Custom app secret token used as Bearer; store ID in path. API only for paid-plan stores, but Ecwid offers a free paid-plan upgrade for developer test stores on email request. No test mode. Ecwid docs index has no MCP page; only aggregator MCPs (Zapier, viasocket, etc.) found; no vendor or verified community repo.

name: Amazon Selling Partner

evidence.quote: An LWA access token expires one hour after it is issued.
The decision to grant or deny Selling Partner API access is made based on the information that you provide in your Developer Profile
you must direct your requests to the correct endpoint based on your target Amazon store.
The @amazon-sp-api-release/sp-api-dev-mcp package is a local MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for SP-API

notes: Login with Amazon (LWA) OAuth tokens. Private developers sign in through Seller Central (requires a selling account) and submit a Developer Profile reviewed by Amazon; public developers go through Solution Provider Portal with identity verification. Sandbox exists but only after registration. Regional hosts (na/eu/fe). Amazon's own amzn GitHub org ships a local dev-assistant MCP (docs/workflow builder), not a hosted data MCP.

name: DataForSEO

evidence.quote: Note that the API password is generated automatically by DataForSEO and is different from your account password.
Your account will not be charged for using Sandbox endpoints
$50 minimum top-up
Sandbox is a technical environment for developers where DataForSEO API can be used without unnecessary expenses.
Add the remote DataForSEO MCP server in your terminal.

notes: HTTP Basic with API login/password from app.dataforseo.com/api-access. Free signup with free Sandbox; live data is pay-as-you-go with $50 minimum top-up. Many APIs (SERP, Keywords Data, Labs, Backlinks, On-Page). Official remote MCP at mcp.dataforseo.com/v3/mcp (also a local package).

name: SE Ranking

evidence.quote: You have two methods to authenticate your requests. We strongly recommend using the Authorization header.
API access is included in every SE Ranking plan
Retrieve instant, structured JSON responses with up to 10 requests per second.
MCP server server follows the authenticated remote MCP spec, so it's centrally hosted and managed.

notes: API key (header 'Authorization: Token KEY') from API Dashboard; Data API + Project API + Local Marketing API. Free trial (no card; MCP page advertises 100K free credits) then paid plans; API keys live with the master account, sub-accounts must ask admin. Official remote MCP at https://api.seranking.com/mcp with OAuth 2.1 or X-Api-Key.

name: Vercel

evidence.quote: Vercel Access Tokens are required to authenticate and use the Vercel API.
Vercel Pricing: Hobby, Pro, and Enterprise plans
Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>
Vercel MCP is Vercel's official MCP server. It's a remote MCP with OAuth

notes: Free Hobby plan ($0) lets you create personal access tokens. OAuth for Integrations marketplace. Official remote MCP at mcp.vercel.com.

name: Sentry

evidence.quote: Authentication tokens are passed using an auth header, and are used to authenticate as a user or organization account with the API.
Pricing: Free Developer Plan, Pay as You Grow | Sentry
'Authorization: Bearer {TOKEN}'
All connections use OAuth. The first connection will trigger an authentication flow to connect to your Sentry account.

notes: Free Developer plan; user auth tokens / org tokens as Bearer; OAuth for public integrations. Official remote MCP at mcp.sentry.dev/mcp. EU data-region orgs use a regional host; not treated as a blocker. Self-hosted Sentry also exists.

name: Asana

evidence.quote: (PAT) is the quickest and simplest way to authenticate in the API.
For one or two people managing personal projects.
The primary feature of Asana's platform is our rest API, so we recommend getting familiar with how our API works.
The Asana MCP V2 server is available at: https://mcp.asana.com/v2/mcp

notes: Free Personal plan ($0, free forever); PATs self-generated; OAuth and Service Accounts (Enterprise) also. Official remote MCP v2 (OAuth); workspace admins can block MCP client apps.

name: ClickUp

evidence.quote: Authenticate to the ClickUp API using a personal token or OAuth.
Is the Free Forever Plan really free?
Build integrations and apps with our Public API.
ClickUp's MCP Server is available on all plans

notes: Personal token (pk_...) sent raw in Authorization header, or OAuth. Free Forever plan. Official remote MCP at mcp.clickup.com/mcp, OAuth 2.1 only (no API keys), rate limits vary by plan and may change.

name: Stripe

evidence.quote: Provide your API key as the basic auth username value. You don't need to provide a password.
To use a service in live mode, verify your business and complete its activation requirements.
In both test mode and live mode, you can create as many restricted API keys as you need
Use OAuth when a client accesses Stripe on behalf of your Stripe user account.

notes: Free signup with sandboxes/test-mode keys immediately; live mode requires business verification (KYC). Secret/restricted keys via Basic or Bearer; Stripe Connect OAuth for platforms. Official remote MCP at mcp.stripe.com (OAuth or restricted key); local option also exists.

name: PitchBook

evidence.quote: help you establish the API connection through an API key or authentication token.
Our API is a separate offering from the PitchBook Platform that requires a standalone contract agreement.
The PitchBook API is a RESTful implementation that most HTTP clients can easily access
Only licensed PitchBook users can access the connector.

notes: pitchbook.com is behind a JS/Cloudflare challenge; pages read via WebFetch summarizer (quotes as returned). API requires a standalone contract via the Direct Data team. Official 'Premium Connector' is built on MCP, SSO auth, licensed users only (seat, unlimited or trial license); no public MCP URL given, so MCP path is not self-serve. api_breadth 'moderate' is a judgment; endpoint catalogue not publicly readable.

name: Devin

evidence.quote: All API credentials use the cog_ prefix format. Include your token in the Authorization header of every request
Go to Settings > Devin API in your organization and open the Service users tab
Teams is self-serve at a flat $80/month.
Set up Devin API access for a teams or standard organization: provision a service user, copy the API key, and create your first session.
The Devin MCP server is an authenticated service that provides access to both public and private repositories, plus full platform management capabilities.

notes: Bearer cog_ tokens: personal access tokens or service-user keys (provisioned from org settings). Pricing table shows a 'Devin API' row with '-' for Free; exact paid tiers including API could not be read (icons), so treated as paid plan. Many v3 endpoints marked Enterprise-only (sessions, playbooks, metrics etc. for enterprise). Official remote MCP at https://mcp.devin.ai/ requiring a Devin API key.

name: Grain

evidence.quote: The token has the same permissions as the user who generated it.
Best for personal automations or testing. Available on every plan, including Free.
The Grain API lets developers read meeting data, manage recordings, and receive real-time events from Grain programmatically.
Grain's MCP server uses OAuth and HTTPS.

notes: Personal Access Token on Free plan; Workspace Access Token needs admin and Business/Enterprise; OAuth2 for distributed integrations. 300 req/min per token. Official hosted MCP (Claude/ChatGPT connector; developer docs at developers.grain.com/mcp); some MCP tools gated to Business & Enterprise.
